ORG_UNIT audiences are a declared non-goal pending identity-projection carrying ou_id; that change touches a shared starter and pulls crud-service-example into the gate.

The emailed audience and live visibility can diverge for somebody who loses the targeted role mid-run. Specified, tested and documented rather than resolved - resolving it would mean a long run sending to a different audience than the one approved.

audienceTotal is never populated, so the operation envelope's progress always reports a null total. Honest (the field is nullable for exactly this) but a caller cannot show a percentage; counting the audience up front would delay the first send.

No cache on the announcement feed. Correct before fast, and the design records that if one is ever needed its CachePurpose is security, not performance - the TTL would be how long a revoked role keeps seeing an admin announcement.
README.ru.md still has no 'Build and test' section, so the updated test counts appear only in the English README. Pre-existing drift.
